class Solution:
    def distributeCandies(self, candies: int, num_people: int) -> List[int]:
        res = [0] * num_people
        give = 1
        i = 0
        while candies > 0:
            take = min(give, candies)
            res[i % num_people] += take
            candies -= take
            give += 1
            i += 1
        return res
